name: JS Global Lifestyle Company Limited
summary: JS Global Lifestyle Company Limited researches, designs, makes and sells small household appliances in mainland China, North America, Europe and elsewhere, mainly through its SharkNinja and Joyoung segments. Its range includes upright, robotic and stick vacuums, steam mops, blenders, soymilk makers, food processors, rice and pressure cookers, air fryers, coffee makers, water purifiers and garment care items. It also provides sales, installation and maintenance, supply chain and consulting services.
